payload.summary: RI-03 now has an evidence-first, independently reviewed plan that separates landed foundations from genuine residual work, preserves current requirements through manual sync matrices, and proves the final actionable inventory before and after self-archive.
completed_work: validated strict OpenSpec and the fully ordered work-package graph

decisions.title: Classify by current evidence
decisions.rationale: Stale task counts cannot prove implementation and several checked requirements contradict current durable workflow behavior.

decisions.title: Extract four bounded successors
decisions.rationale: Filtering, source overrides, LLM operationalization, and ParadeDB/Langfuse production proof are real gaps but must not reopen completed foundations.

decisions.title: Use manual requirement merges before archive
decisions.rationale: Legacy or overclaimed deltas cannot be synced wholesale without losing newer main-spec scenarios or publishing unsupported behavior.

decisions.title: Prove a final snapshot, not a permanent registry
decisions.rationale: The reconciliation evidence must remain stable while later roadmap lifecycle transitions continue.

next_steps: merge specs and archive historical entries
